question: Why does the rule "Test behavior before or alongside production code" matter in a code review?

expected_rule_sections.heading: Test behavior before or alongside production code
heading_path: Clean Code, Chapter 14: Testing Disciplines, PR review rules
Test behavior before or alongside production code

relevant_concepts: Test behavior before or alongside production code

question: What review guidance applies to "Keep tests focused on observable behavior"?

expected_rule_sections.heading: Keep tests focused on observable behavior
heading_path: Clean Code, Chapter 14: Testing Disciplines, PR review rules
Keep tests focused on observable behavior

relevant_concepts: Keep tests focused on observable behavior
Behavior-focused tests protect the contract while allowing implementation improvements. Tests coupled to structure become a barrier to clean design and can pass while the real behavior is wrong.

question: Why does the rule "Cover branches and failure paths in each small bundle" matter in a code review?

expected_rule_sections.heading: Cover branches and failure paths in each small bundle
heading_path: Clean Code, Chapter 14: Testing Disciplines, PR review rules
Cover branches and failure paths in each small bundle

relevant_concepts: Cover branches and failure paths in each small bundle
A passing happy-path test does not establish that the new behavior is safe. Branch and failure tests expose the cases most likely to produce regressions in production.
